The game was released in [[Mainland China]] on 21 December 2023, and later released worldwide on 3 December 2024 (by Darkwinter Software) or 5 December 2024 (by HaoPlay) depending on region.{{cite web|url=https://gachaghost.com/girls-frontline-2-exilium-release-guide/|title=Girls' Frontline 2 Global Launch: What You Need to Know|author=Ján Varga|date=26 November 2024|website=Gacha Ghost|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241119214956/https://gachaghost.com/girls-frontline-2-exilium-release-guide/|archive-date=19 November 2024|url-status=live}} ==Gameplay== {{Multiple image|total_width = 480 | align = right | direction = vertical | width = 480 | image1 = Girls Frontline 2 interface.jpg | caption1 = In-game combat interface screenshot of the main game mode, with the character [[Suomi KP/-31|Suomi]] selected | image2 = Girls Frontline 2 Boundary Push interface.jpg | caption2 = Screenshot of the alternate "Boundary Push" game mode, playing as the character [[Robinson Armament XCR|Sharkry]] | image3 = Girls Frontline 2 dormitory interface.jpg | caption3 = Crew deck mode screenshot, with the player character depicted in the centre }} The gameplay of ''Girls{{'}} Frontline 2'' revolves around turn-based tactical battles which take place on grid levels, similar to games such as ''[[XCOM]]'', ''[[Disgaea]]'', and ''[[Shadowrun#Video games|Shadowrun]]''.{{cite web|url=https://www.rpgsite.net/news/16610-girls-frontline-2-exilium-release-date-set-for-december-3-on-pc-mobile|title=Girls Frontline 2: Exilium release date set for December 3 on PC and mobile|author=Josh Tolentino|date=30 November 2024|website=RPGSite|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241201105247/https://www.rpgsite.net/news/16610-girls-frontline-2-exilium-release-date-set-for-december-3-on-pc-mobile|archive-date=1 December 2024|url-status=live}}{{cite web|url=https://www.pocketgamer.com/gfl2-exilium/review/|title=Girls Frontline 2: Exilium review - "The serenade of firearms and songbirds of gunfight"|author=Anderson Han|date=18 March 2024|website=[[Pocket Gamer]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240318135521/https://www.pocketgamer.com/gfl2-exilium/review/|archive-date=18 March 2024|url-status=live}}{{cite web|url=http://www.gamelook.com.cn/2024/07/549806|title=《少女前线2》要在海外打"复活赛"，国外玩家：它独一无二！ 戏新生？ |language=zh|date=22 July 2024|website=Gamelook|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240804023754/http://www.gamelook.com.cn/2024/07/549806|archive-date=4 August 2024|url-status=live}} The player commands a squad of units in order to fulfil mission objectives on a tactical map, which include destroying enemy units, capturing strategic points, surviving waves of enemy attacks, or evacuating all units to an extraction point.{{cite web|url=https://esports.gg/news/girls-frontline-2/girls-frontline-2/|title=Girls' Frontline 2: Global release date, platforms and gameplay|date=4 October 2024|website=esports.gg|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241126203019/https://esports.gg/news/girls-frontline-2/girls-frontline-2/|archive-date=26 November 2024|url-status=live}} These playable units, which are combat androids called T-Dolls, are obtained by the player via a [[Gacha game|gacha]] system in standard and seasonal event [[Glossary of video game terms#B|banners]] using in-game currencies.{{cite web|url=https://gamerant.com/girls-frontline-2-exilium-reroll-guide-gfl2/|title=Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium - Reroll Guide|author=Marc Santos|date=6 December 2024|website=Gamerant|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250109141638/https://gamerant.com/girls-frontline-2-exilium-reroll-guide-gfl2/|archive-date=9 January 2025|url-status=live}}{{cite web|url=https://www.prydwen.gg/gfl-exilium/guides/gacha-explained/|title=Gacha System Guide|date=1 December 2024|website=pyrdwen.gg|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241226160546/https://www.prydwen.gg/gfl-exilium/guides/gacha-explained/|archive-date=26 December 2024|url-status=live}} === Character classes === T-Dolls are categorised into four different classes, namely:{{cite web|url=https://www.prydwen.gg/gfl-exilium/guides/characters-and-progression/|title=Characters & Progression|date=30 November 2024|website=pyrdwen.gg|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241223033315/https://www.prydwen.gg/gfl-exilium/guides/characters-and-progression/|archive-date=23 December 2024|url-status=live}} *'''Sentinel''': Primary damage dealing units with high [[Glossary of video game terms#Damage per second|DPS]] *'''Bulwark''': [[Tank (video games)|Tanking]] units with high survivability and defensive abilities *'''Support''': Units with [[Healer (video games)|healing]] and [[Status effect#Buffs and debuffs|buffing]] abilities *'''Vanguard''': Units with high mobility that act in a sub-DPS capacity === Battle mechanics === In addition to a standard attack and a passive skill, T-Dolls have active skills that often consume "confectance index", a resource akin to [[Statistic (role-playing games)|ability point]]s in standard [[role-playing game]]s. These skills provide unique offensive or defensive capabilities depending on the T-Doll and have [[Glossary of video game terms#C|cooldown periods]]. Each T-Doll boasts an ultimate skill in their kit, which typically costs confectance as well. Confectance index replenishes over time or can be restored using certain active skills.{{cite web|url=https://www.prydwen.gg/gfl-exilium/guides/combat-guide/|title=Combat Guide|date=19 November 2024|website=pyrdwen.gg|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241227124749/https://www.prydwen.gg/gfl-exilium/guides/combat-guide/|archive-date=27 December 2024|url-status=live}} All units, both player-controlled and enemy-controlled, have a "stability index" which gradually decreases as they receive attacks from other units; when this is reduced to zero, "stability break" occurs, which reduces the effect of [[Enfilade and defilade#Defilade|battlefield cover]]. The combat map offers locations with varying cover which reduces the amount of damage a unit receives, and the player is able to mitigate the effect of enemy cover with [[Flanking maneuver|positional flanking]], [[Glossary of video game terms#A|area-of-effect]] attacks, [[melee]] attacks, and elevated tiles which negate the efficacy of cover, or by reducing the enemy unit's stability index to zero. Other forms of environmental effectors on the map include hazard tiles which apply damage or negative status effects to units, and interactable levers that alter elevators, conveyor belts or turrets on the battlefield. Beginning from the ''Chiral Redundancy'' major update onwards, a mechanism was introduced where tile effects generated by special unit skills that belong to different elemental types can be stacked together, for instance using an active attack to apply fire status to an existing ice tile, allowing the player to create additional status effects that apply to units occupying the tiles.{{cite web|url=https://shouyou.3dmgame.com/gl/614523.html|title=《少女前线2：追放》地格衍变系统介绍|website=[[:zh:3DMGAME|3DMGAME]]|date=18 March 2026|language=zh|url-status=live|archive-url=https://megalodon.jp/2026-0320-1647-30/https://shouyou.3dmgame.com:443/gl/614523.html|archive-date=20 March 2026}}{{cbignore}} === Min-max optimization === The combat ability of T-Dolls can be enhanced by increasing their training level, altering their weapon and attachment loadouts, fortifying the T-Doll using duplicates obtained via the gacha system, unlocking enhancement nodes on each T-Doll's "neural helix", and equipping "keys" which provide modifiers to abilities or stats.{{cite web|url=https://www.4gamer.net/games/631/G063178/20250319043/|title=「ドールズフロントライン2：エクシリウム」に待望のHK416こと"クルカイ"実装！ 最強アタッカーと噂されるその実力をレポートしよう|date=20 March 2025|website=4gamer|language=ja|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250320080141/https://www.4gamer.net/games/631/G063178/20250319043/|archive-date=20 March 2025|url-status=live|quote=素体のままでもクルカイは強力な存在だが，ボス敵に対し強力な火力を発揮できない問題を抱えている…そこを補うのがフレーム解放となる。フレームIIIに到達すれば，ヘビードリフトがLV2に強化され，攻撃前にターゲットへ防御低下IIと毒性侵入のデバフを付与する…ノードの強化によってHPや攻撃力のアップ，必殺技「ヘビードリフト」のダメージ上昇などさまざまな効果が得られる。特殊ノードを解放した際に発生するノードコンボボーナスもクルカイの性能を底上げしてくれるので，接続媒体を積極的に投入したほうが良いだろう。|trans-quote=Klukai has a powerful presence even in her base loadout, but she has a weakness of not being able to provide strong enough firepower against boss enemies... Duplicate segment fortification makes up for that shortcoming. When she reaches Segment 03, Devastating Drift is strengthened to level 2, allowing her to apply the Defense Down II and Toxic Infiltration debuffs to the target before attacking... Strengthening neural helix nodes can have various effects, such as increasing HP and attack power, along with increasing the damage of her ultimate move "Devastating Drift". The extra advancement bonus that occurs when you unlock an evolved node also improves the performance of Klukai, so it is a good idea to use transcription conductors on her.}} Standard rarity T-Dolls can also be upgraded to "elite" rarity after collecting the required upgrade materials, providing additional attribute boosts and granting new combat skills.{{cite web|url=https://shouyou.3dmgame.com/gl/614426.html|title=《少女前线2：追放》人形升格介绍|website=[[:zh:3DMGAME|3DMGAME]]|date=17 March 2026|language=zh|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260320081340/https://shouyou.3dmgame.com/gl/614426.html|archive-date=20 March 2026}} === Other elements === A secondary game mode, known as "Boundary Push", involves the player controlling T-Dolls in real-time as they traverse through a large dungeon stage to collect [[Loot (video games)|loot pickups]] and locate the [[Boss (video games)|stage boss]], making use of [[Stealth game#Game design|stealth mechanics]] and environmental hazards to reach the objective.{{cite magazine|url=https://www.famitsu.com/article/202503/36352|title=『ドルフロ2』新SSR人形・クルカイが登場、マキアートが再ピックアップ。"H.I.D.E.404"メンバーたちが、秘密組織"パラデウス"の陰謀に立ち向かうイベント"遠日点"がスタート|date=20 March 2025|magazine=[[Famitsu]]|language=ja|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250320071053/https://www.famitsu.com/article/202503/36352|archive-date=20 March 2025|url-status=live|quote=さらに、2025年3月24日からは新たなゲームモード“ダークゾーン”も登場する。こちらは、敵ユニットが巡回する各エリア内の補給箱を集めていくモードだ。敵ユニットの索敵範囲外で攻撃すると一撃で倒すことができ、火薬箱を爆発させれば広範囲の敵ユニットを一層させられる。エリア内には敵ユニットに察知されない草むらがあり、うまく活用することで、敵を倒さずに無視して突破することも可能。|trans-quote=Furthermore, a new game mode, "Boundary Push", will be introduced on 24 March 2025. In this mode, you collect supply boxes in each area while avoiding enemy patrol units. If you attack an enemy unit outside of its visibility range, you can destroy it in one shot, and if you detonate an explosive barrel, you can destroy enemy units over a wider area. There are grass patches throughout the stage that prevent detection by enemy units, and by using them well, you can ignore the enemies and infiltrate through without fighting them.}}{{cite web|url=https://www.inven.co.kr/webzine/news/?news=304125|title=HK416과 G11 등장, '소녀전선2' 원일점 업데이트|author=Yoon Seo-ho|date=20 March 2025|website=[[:ko:인벤|Inven]]|language=ko|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250320071129/https://www.inven.co.kr/webzine/news/?news=304125|archive-date=20 March 2025|url-status=live|quote=아울러 상시 콘텐츠 '변경 추진'도 추가된다. '변경 추진'은 커다란 던전 맵에서 실시간으로 캐릭터를 컨트롤하여 맵 곳곳에 숨겨진 보물상자를 수집하고 보스를 격파하는 콘텐츠다. 전투를 통해 처치하지 않더라도 잠입과 은신으로 우회하거나, 혼자 고립된 적을 일격에 암살할 수 있는 전략적 요소도 포함되어 있다.|trans-quote=In addition, the permanent game mode "Boundary Push" will be added. Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium is a turn-based tactical strategy game developed by MICA Team, in which players command squads of android characters, known in-universe as T-Dolls, armed with firearms and melee blades. It is the sequel to Girls' Frontline, set ten years after its closing events. 
The game was released in Mainland China on 21 December 2023, and later released worldwide on 3 December 2024 (by Darkwinter Software) or 5 December 2024 (by HaoPlay) depending on region.
